author: Zegita
body:
IGN: Zegita

Firstly, I would just like to say I was not spawn killing - I was shooting the people that came OUT of spawn not IN the spawn. If I was spawn killing that would mean they would have resistance for about 5 seconds and it would take me forever to kill them thus I did not do that because THAT is spawn killing. Spawn killing is not when you kill someone OUTSIDE of spawn. I wasn't close to spawn either. Furthermore, there is no evidence that I was spawn killing - no video proof, no pictures nothing just a kick. You can ask other witnesses that I was not spawn killing like I said spawn killing is when you're controlling THE SPAWN not OUTSIDE - I was shooting people when they were about 20 blocks away from their spawn it was close to their spawn BUT NOT IN THEIR SPAWN.

Furthermore, it also states in the rules (https://avicus.net/rules/en) you have to control the spawn. You have to kill someone or it's not spawn killing (in the spawn - which I did not do because like I said that would take forever). Hurting someone is also not spawn killing so technically I did play by the rules.

title: Kicked for Spawn Killing

replies.author: Spoookeh
replies.body:
Hey Zeg,

Firstly, I kicked and didn't warn you because you had been punished for the same thing yesterday and I thought you would have had a better understanding of the rules.

You did shoot into the spawn directly because I was afk for a few minutes there and I had been shot. However, you were shooting into spawn with no intent to kill players you didn't actually kill anyone and only damaged them.

I am therefore willing to appeal this infraction, be sure not to do anything like this again though and read the rules fully. Thanks for your time c:

- Spoookeh
